name: Captain Greenskin
summary: In the Deadmines cove, Captain Greenskin readies a warship for Edwin VanCleef. The goblin pirate oversees its crew and construction for the Defias Brotherhood, preparing the ironclad juggernaut to sail against Stormwind.

sections.title: Master of the Juggernaut
sections.body: Captain Greenskin paces the main deck of the juggernaut under construction in the Deadmines cove. A seasoned goblin mariner, he was brought into Edwin VanCleef's inner circle to turn an underground cavern into a drydock for a warship.

sections.title: A Pirate's Crew
sections.body: Captain Greenskin commands cutthroats, not stonemasons or bandits. His crew includes Mr. Smite, his fearsome tauren first mate, and Cookie, the murloc ship's cook. Together, they hold the gangplanks and upper deck, guarding the way to VanCleef's private cabin atop the bridge.

faq.answer: Captain Greenskin is a goblin pirate captain hired by Edwin VanCleef to oversee the completion and operation of the Defias Brotherhood's secret warship in the Deadmines.

faq.q: Where did Greenskin come from before joining the Defias?
faq.answer: No record tells where Greenskin sailed before entering VanCleef's pay. He commands the Defias juggernaut and its crew in the Deadmines.
Greenskin commands Mr. Smite, his tauren first mate, Cookie, the murloc cook, and Defias pirates patrolling the ironclad's deck.

faq.q: What is Greenskin's purpose in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: Greenskin is charged with making the massive ironclad warship seaworthy and ready to sail from the underground cove into the Great Sea against Stormwind.

faq.q: Where can Captain Greenskin be found?
faq.answer: Captain Greenskin paces the main deck of the large juggernaut anchored in the final cavern of the Deadmines, guarding the approach to Edwin VanCleef.

faq.q: Is Captain Greenskin part of the Defias Brotherhood or a mercenary?
faq.answer: Captain Greenskin is a mercenary pirate captain in Edwin VanCleef's direct employ, commanding the naval forces aligned with the Defias Brotherhood's plot.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Captain Greenskin commands the Defias rebellion's maritime threat. If his juggernaut reaches the coast, Westfall and Stormwind's undefended shores are at direct risk.
As a rogue, you find Greenskin at the head of Defias piracy, heavily guarded by corsairs and brutes on the warship's deck.
